messages:
Maya: Heads up — SummitTrust asked for a 1-week POC next Tue. They flagged SSO (SAML signed assertions), SCIM for ~1M users (initial bulk seed + daily deltas), strict RBAC by OU, domain-locked tenants (no self-serve), and longer audit retention. Also asked to compare Dedicated-for-POC vs Private timeline/pricing. @Arjun can you confirm seed strategy and SCIM throughput?

Arjun: Short answer: bulk import for initial 1M (single compressed file) + PATCH-based deltas. Hosted SCIM default handles ~400-600 req/s per customer; for large onboarding we enable higher limits and give a parallel worker pattern with exponential backoff. For idempotent deltas we recommend PATCH upserts. Example delta skeleton we send customers:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [{ "value": "user-5555", "displayName": "Alex Roe" }]
    }
  ]
}
```
Validated IdPs: Okta, Azure AD. OneLogin less exercised — recommend smoke test. Groups -> RBAC mapping supported; we'll share a mapping template.

Priya: Security checklist items for the RFP: exchange SAML metadata (IdP + SP), signature and audience checks, recommended assertion window (5m), clock-skew tolerance, SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated guidance. SCIM: scoped tokens per tenant, rotation cadence (90d), optional mTLS for Private, IP allowlist. Audit logs: hosted = 30d default, Dedicated = configurable as add-on (90/180d), Private = customer-managed with archival to their S3. Encryption: AES-256 at rest + KMS; TLS1.2+ in transit.

Leo: Commercials note: We can provision a temporary Dedicated slice for a short POC (2 weeks) — estimated infra surcharge ~$1.1k/day + one-time SCIM seed ops ~$2k. Private has min term and ~3w lead. I'll confirm final numbers with finance and post here today.

Maya: They want domain proofing and tenant-locking: no self-signup, automatic tenant mapping for verified domains, and DNS TXT proofing docs. Can we support auto-map of verified-email domains to tenants?

Arjun: Yes. Support DNS TXT verification, then enable domain-lock to prevent tenant creation from unverified domains. Auto-map on auth if email domain matches a verified tenant. Also support SAML attribute mapping -> groups -> RBAC. We'll provide attribute mapping examples (e.g., eduPersonPrincipalName, custom attributes).

Priya: For SCIM safety: recommend dry-run (no-op) for seed, snapshot before seed, and idempotent upserts to avoid accidental deletes. Also enable provisioning audit export for compliance reviewers. We'll include export API examples in the RFP appendix.

Maya: Good. I'll draft an RFP appendix with: bulk seed + delta flow, security checklist, RBAC mapping examples, rollback/safe-seed checklist, and required IdP attributes. @Leo please post POC pricing + timeline by EOD. Need tech kickoff with their infra and IdP engineer.

calendar-bot: Created event "SummitTrust POC kickoff" Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 — invites: Maya, Arjun, Priya, Leo, summit-infra.

Maya: One more — Summit asked how long SAML auth events are retained and whether we can export them for forensics. Priya?

Priya: Hosted auth event retention = 30d; exportable via API to their S3 for longer retention. Dedicated = configurable retention/export as add-on. Private = full customer control and archival. Will add example export curl commands to the appendix. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Also they want assurance we can prevent mass-deletes during seed. Arjun, can eng expose a dry-run flag and pre-run validation in the import tool?

Arjun: Yes — we'll surface dry-run and a validation report (counts, orphan checks) before mutating. We'll also provide a recommended throttled apply mode.

Leo: Finance confirmed draft numbers via DM; posting final quote in here by 6pm.

Maya: Thanks team — I'll send the RFP appendix to Summit and add the kickoff meeting link.
